sources.title: mgoin/GLM-5.2-speculator.dspark · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview A DSpark speculator model for the zai-org/GLM-5.2-FP8 base model, enabling faster inference through speculative decoding. DSpark extends the DFlash parallel draft backbone with two lightweight heads: a Markov logit-bias head (low-rank intra-block token dependency) and a per-position confidence head (accept-rate prediction). Trained with the speculators library.

sources.title: zai-org/GLM-5.2 | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: GLM-5.2 is the newest model in the GLM-5 series — a ~743B-parameter MoE (39B active) from Z-AI. The headline change over GLM-5 / 5.1 is that Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) is extended from 3 to 5 draft tokens, lifting end-to-end throughput on reasoning, coding, and agentic workloads.

sources.title: GLM-5.2 on NVIDIA DGX Spark clusters - GitHub
sources.snippet: Legacy: GLM-5.2 469B on 3× NVIDIA DGX Spark Serve the GLM-5.2-NVFP4-REAP-469B model (753B → 469B REAP-pruned, NVFP4 quantized) across a cluster of three NVIDIA DGX Spark nodes using vLLM with pipeline parallelism.
